instruction:
Coordination Cleanup IFC And Revit Plan Sheet PDF

This task starts from C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\init.ifc and uses the local reference image C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\init_sheet.png. In Revit, clean up the starting coordination model, export the model as C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.ifc, and export a one-page Revit plan sheet as C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.pdf in the Desktop.

## Pass conditions
1. The output folder contains C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.ifc and C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.pdf; C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.ifc is at least 500 bytes and C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.pdf is at least 200 bytes.
2. C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.ifc uses an IFC4 schema.
3. All IfcRoot GlobalId values are unique.
4. The IFC model contains exactly 1 IfcProject, 1 IfcSite, 1 IfcBuilding, 1 IfcBuildingStorey, 2 IfcSpace entities, 5 IfcWall entities, 1 IfcSlab, 1 IfcDoor, and 3 IfcWindow entities.
5. The IFC model contains 0 IfcRoof, 0 IfcCurtainWall, 0 IfcBuildingElementProxy, 0 IfcStair, 0 IfcColumn, and 0 IfcBeam entities.
6. The normalized IfcSpace name list contains the exact space names coord room a and coord room b.
7. C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.pdf contains exactly 1 page exported from a Revit sheet.
8. The extracted text from C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.pdf contains the case-insensitive tokens COORDINATION CLEANUP and A101.

Any item not explicitly required in the pass conditions may vary.
